props.name: defaultLocale
props.comment: Ignored when it is not one of `locales`. Defaults to the app locale when listed, else the first locale.

props.name: groupKey
props.comment: Prefix that keeps the ids of two groups apart. Defaults to `""`.

props.name: record
props.comment: The record to show. Defaults to the ambient record.

props.name: resource
props.comment: The resource the fields belong to. Defaults to the ambient resource.
